annotations.title: X（旧 Twitter）の投稿の文字数（日本語は140字）

description: Count the length of a post on X (formerly Twitter) exactly as X does, using X's official twitter-text library: weighted characters where CJK (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) and emoji count 2, most Latin characters count 1, every URL counts 23, text is NFC-normalized, and the limit is 280 (about 140 Japanese characters). It is meant for checking X posts, especially Japanese ones, against the limit. is_valid is also false for an empty text or text with characters X does not accept. Counts only the text given (auto-added reply @mentions and attached media are not counted by X). Long posts for paid accounts are not covered; the text may be at most 1,000 UTF-16 code units, also after NFC normalization. The text is not stored or returned.

text.description: 数える本文（UTF-16 で 1,000 まで。NFC にした後も 1,000 まで）
